world.h: UN watchdog urges Iran to reopen nuclear sites to inspectors
world.b: The IAEA called the lack of information about Iran's nuclear material a proliferation concern needing urgent action, citing an enrichment plant near Isfahan.

world.h: Finland detects strike on Russian warship
world.b: Finland's military said it detected a strike on a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland area, and Ukraine's Security Service reportedly said it carried out the attack.

world.h: Iran says it struck US radar site in Bahrain
world.b: The Revolutionary Guard called the strike a serious warning over what it said were aerial provocations and oil smuggling in the Strait of Hormuz; there was no immediate comment from Washington or Manama.

world.h: Qatar, Turkiye ink defence pact; UN warns of displacement crisis in Yemen
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Qatar, Turkiye ink defence pact; UN warns of displacement crisis in Yemen

world.h: Albania says 2027 NATO summit won't be in Tirana
world.b: Albania's prime minister said a summit would come to Tirana in 2028 if held, as NATO weighs ending its annual summits.

world.h: European leaders meet in Dublin as hybrid attacks mount
world.b: Leaders from more than 40 countries gathered after a wave of hoaxes and cyberattacks hit supermarkets, blood banks, airlines, schools and media across Europe.

world.h: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow on Ukraine war
world.b: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Putin for about two hours, then headed to Dublin for talks with Zelenskyy after US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi ended without a major breakthrough.

world.h: Iran warns of wider retaliation as Israel readies possible strike
world.b: Israel's security cabinet ordered the military to step up preparations for an attack on Iran, Israeli media reported, and Iran warned it would expand the war beyond the region if attacked. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot urged caretaker PM Netanyahu not to act without an immediate threat.

world.h: US, Mexico and Guatemala at risk of losing measles-free status
world.b: A Pan American Health Organization commission is reviewing measles elimination across the Americas this week. The US, which has held the status since 2000, is facing its largest and deadliest outbreak in nearly 30 years.

national.h: Supreme Court to hear Trump's southern border asylum ban
national.b: The administration wants the justices to overturn lower court rulings that found it illegal to block asylum applications under the order.
national.title: Supreme Court will consider Trump’s executive order suspending asylum access at the southern border

national.h: Tanker strikes New Orleans river cruise boat
national.b: The tanker hit the paddlewheel boat American Heritage, carrying 129 passengers, on the Mississippi, partially submerging it as rescues got underway.
national.title: Rescues operations underway in New Orleans after tanker hits river cruise boat

national.h: FAA grounds all flights at US airports
national.b: A communications problem at regional air traffic control centers prompted the first nationwide ground stop since 2023; officials said there was no indication yet of an attack.
national.title: FAA grounds all flights at U.S. airports due to air traffic control communications problems

national.h: Navy quietly fired commanders, drawing pushback from Congress
national.b: Democratic lawmakers say the Navy didn't tell Congress it fired a submarine's entire leadership team after an underwater collision, breaking with its practice of announcing removals.

national.h: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who chastised him
national.b: After a viral rebuke over decorum at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on Veterans Day, the defense secretary sought to turn the incident into a PR opportunity.

national.h: Advocacy groups sue AI companies to pause new models
national.b: The suit against Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX argues the companies cannot keep their AI from causing catastrophic harm and asks for a pause until safeguards exist.

national.h: USDA plans rule that could cut SNAP for 6.3 million
national.b: A proposed rule would end automatic SNAP eligibility for some families on TANF cash aid; the agency says about 6.3 million people could lose benefits by fiscal 2029.

national.h: Gunman shoots 5 in DC, killing 1, then dies by suicide
national.b: Police say the gunman opened fire at a VIDA Fitness gym in Logan Circle, about a mile north of the White House, then barricaded himself in an adjoining apartment, where he shot himself.

national.h: Trump's college accreditation overhaul set to take effect
national.b: A largely unnoticed change to college accreditation, which Trump called his "secret weapon" to reclaim schools from "the radical left," takes effect in July.

national.h: Guard reprimands Hegseth entourage at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
national.b: Video shows an Old Guard sentinel loudly telling members of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's group to keep silence and respect after they laughed while taking photos on Veterans Day.

politics.h: Boebert loses House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher
politics.b: The former Navy rear admiral won Colorado's 4th District, one of several surprising Republican losses this cycle.
politics.title: GOP Rep. Lauren Boebert of Colorado loses U.S. House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher

politics.h: Democrats weigh RFK Jr. impeachment while courting MAHA voters
politics.b: Some top lawmakers have floated impeaching Kennedy, but that could clash with efforts to win over his Make America Healthy Again supporters.

politics.h: Van Hollen to challenge Schumer for majority leader
politics.b: The Maryland senator said midterm voters want change from the status quo and Democrats need new leadership.

politics.h: Trump says he wants to 'get Cuba done' before leaving office
politics.b: Politico reported it was the first time Trump has put a timeline on a possible operation to topple Cuba's government.

politics.h: Trump tells Vance to shift focus from Iran to crime
politics.b: Trump said in a social media post that the US doesn't need a deal with Iran, after Vance blamed the war for Republicans' midterm losses.
politics.title: Trump bluntly tells JD Vance to shift focus from Iran to targeting 'corruption and crime' at home

politics.h: Senators probe RFK Jr.'s Samoa trip
politics.b: Sens. Ron Wyden and Angela Alsobrooks opened an inquiry after a letter showed Kennedy's trip before a deadly measles outbreak involved vaccines, despite his testimony.

politics.h: Blumenthal says prosecutor is trying to investigate him
politics.b: The senator said a federal prosecutor in Texas is targeting him over his inquiry into corporate donations to projects Trump supports, writing, "I will not be intimidated."

politics.h: Democrat Cindy Holscher wins Kansas governor's race
politics.b: The AP called the race Thursday for Holscher, a state senator who promised to halt new data centers and overcame heavy Republican spending behind state Senate President Masterson.

politics.h: House passes veterans pay bill amid floor drama
politics.b: The bill would give combat-injured retirees full disability and retirement pay, funded by changing how tinnitus and sleep apnea are rated, a trade-off Democrats opposed.

politics.h: Blue wave slows drop in Black House members
politics.b: After a Supreme Court ruling weakened the Voting Rights Act, Democratic gains limited losses: the next House will have 60 Black members, down from 63, NPR found. Alabama's Shomari Figures won despite a redrawn district.

international.h: At least 10 killed in Guinea clashes over gold mining ban
international.b: Protesters blocked a patrol enforcing the ban on artisanal mining in the Siguiri region, and the standoff turned into an exchange of gunfire.
international.title: At least 10 killed in Guinea clashes over gold mining ban

international.b: The military said the fighters were killed in Balochistan since November 3, with 43 more killed in separate raids in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

international.h: Building collapse near Nairobi kills six
international.b: The top concrete slab gave way while construction workers were on site in Syokimau, and rescuers kept searching for survivors.

international.h: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence pact
international.b: Erdogan's office said the accord adds a new dimension to relations, though it released no further details.
international.title: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement

international.h: Spanish court suspends far-right group Nucleo Nacional
international.b: The ruling follows the arrest of 14 members on suspicion of inciting hatred; police say they seized more than 20 firearms in searches.

international.h: Lebanon asks Syria to hand over suspects in Iraqi ex-MP's killing
international.b: Lebanese prosecutors want two Syrian nationals over the killing of al-Alwani, a critic of Iranian influence in Baghdad; a Lebanese national has been arrested.

international.h: Russian court jails rights lawyer 12 years for treason
international.b: Prosecutors accused her of passing information to Ukraine about security officers in Kaliningrad; the trial was held behind closed doors.

international.h: Pope Leo denounces machismo in Peru
international.b: On his homecoming visit, the Peruvian pope demanded respect for women and told bishops to answer abuse victims with truth and justice.

international.h: Fujairah truck crash kills 14 in UAE
international.b: A truck driver lost control at the entrance to the emirate late Wednesday, setting off a fiery pileup that also injured 30, officials said.

international.h: Palestinian baby dies of cold in Gaza
international.b: A father said his infant son froze to death overnight as cold hit Gaza, while a coalition of more than 50 countries and groups urged Israel to let in shelter, fuel and sanitation supplies.

international.h: Spain approves housing reforms after nationwide strike
international.b: A day after hundreds of thousands walked out over soaring rents, a parliamentary council passed the first of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's reissued decrees extending eviction protections, 35 to 34.

international.h: UK court convicts two men of spying for Iran
international.b: A London court convicted the pair of conduct likely to assist Iran's intelligence service, including targeting Iran International journalists; a third defendant was acquitted.

international.h: Hoax bomb alerts target over 1,800 Italian schools
international.b: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni summoned opposition leaders after the mass emails, and her office said schools should not be evacuated over an email alone without concrete signs of danger.

international.h: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six
international.b: An airstrike hit the surgical wing of Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, killing six including surgeon Rizk Abu Shaira and wounding at least 28, Gaza's Health Ministry said. Israel said it targeted a Hamas commander, without providing evidence.

international.h: Houthis deny targeting Mecca as Yemen fighting intensifies
international.b: The Houthis said they targeted a pumping station in Yanbu and Riyadh's airport, not Mecca, after Saudi-led forces said they intercepted missiles and drones. Saudi civil defence said debris fell in a village in Mecca province.

international.h: Bolivia arrests ex-judge on drug trafficking suspicion
international.b: Former Santa Cruz chief justice Quezada, who resigned after landing on a US visa restriction list, is among several senior Bolivian judicial officials arrested since September over alleged cartel links.

international.h: Amnesty: UN and South Sudan failed to prevent village massacre
international.b: Amnesty says UN peacekeepers and officials knew an attack on Abiemnom was likely but didn't reinforce about three dozen troops before the March 1 assault, which killed more than 200 people.

international.h: Ex-Red Brigades member escapes house arrest in Argentina
international.b: Leonardo Bertulazzi, facing extradition to serve a 27-year sentence in Italy over the kidnapping and killing of a former prime minister, slipped out over neighbouring terraces, prompting a nationwide search.

Gibran Rakabuming Raka, son of former President Joko Widodo, submitted his resignation two years into his term amid court rulings disputing his educational credentials. Parliament will pick a replacement from two presidential nominees within 60 days.

business.h: Airline group says high fares may be the new norm
business.b: Asia-Pacific carriers face jet fuel near $180 a barrel, up from about $80 a year ago, and fuel is a third of operating costs.

business.h: Outlook, Teams hit by widespread Microsoft outage
business.b: Nearly 130,000 Downdetector users reported Outlook problems at the peak, and Microsoft blamed elevated load on part of its infrastructure.
October sales fell 8.8% from a year earlier to 3.75 million, the lowest since 2010, as 30-year mortgage rates reached as high as 7.40%.
business.title: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years

business.b: Huang stepped down Thursday after facing growing calls to resign over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO, and its shares fell 10% in premarket trading.
business.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after his affair raises national security concerns

business.h: Nvidia shares plunge as board weighs Huang's future
business.b: Nvidia stock fell after reports its board will discuss CEO Jensen Huang's position over alleged affairs, including one with a woman accused of working with Chinese intelligence. The company opened an investigation Sunday.

science.h: Florida battles largest dengue outbreak in 15 years
science.b: The state has recorded a record 524 locally acquired cases this year, and helicopters are spraying a natural bacteria that kills mosquito larvae.

sports.h: Red Sox reportedly sign Jake Bauers for $58 million
sports.b: The NLCS MVP agreed to a four-year deal after hitting 26 homers for the champion Brewers, ESPN reports.
sports.title: Jake Bauers reportedly agrees to $58 million deal with Red Sox after helping lead Brewers to World Series

sports.h: Pochettino leaves USMNT for Manchester United
sports.b: He led the US to a Round of 16 finish at the 2026 World Cup, with three wins, the most by a USMNT coach at a World Cup.
The Astros slugger bounced back from an injury-riddled 2025 to hit .316 with 42 homers, leading the majors in average, on-base and slugging.
The Cubs star beat Shohei Ohtani after leading the majors in WAR, runs, home runs and total bases, with 45 homers and 41 steals in all 162 games.

sports.h: Misiorowski and Schlittler win Cy Young awards unanimously
sports.b: Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski (1.80 ERA, 252 strikeouts) and the Yankees' Cam Schlittler (1.95 ERA) swept the NL and AL voting, only the third unanimous pair in MLB history.

sports.h: Kansas routs Kentucky at Champions Classic
sports.b: No. 15 Kansas beat No. 24 Kentucky 89-69 as Tre White scored 30 and Trey Kaufman-Renn added 12 points and six assists, even without injured guard Melvin Council Jr.

sports.h: Michigan State upsets No. 2 Duke at Champions Classic
sports.b: Jeremy Fears Jr. had 18 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds as fifth-ranked Michigan State beat Duke 79-73 at the United Center.

sports.h: Alabama jumps to No. 3 in second CFP rankings
sports.b: Alabama rose two spots to No. 3, the earliest a two-loss team has reached the committee's top four, while Tennessee, which beat the Tide, sits at No. 8. The committee chair cited Alabama's top-ranked strength of schedule.

local.h: Mamdani declines to back Schumer for majority leader
local.b: The mayor said he cares less about who leads Senate Democrats than what they do for the working class.
local.title: Mamdani declines to back fellow New Yorker Schumer as Senate majority leader

local.h: First Code Blue of the winter declared
local.b: The cold weather emergency runs until 8 a.m. Saturday as wind chills near freezing, the first test of the city's expanded outreach plan.
local.title: First Code Blue of the winter season arrives in New York City

local.h: Flatbush collapse fuels anger over pace of development
local.b: Mayor Mamdani says the city is examining 100 other sites tied to the construction companies, as residents say rapid building is displacing longtime neighbors.
local.title: Brooklyn building collapse has residents questioning pace of development

local.b: The bill bars companies from setting prices based on personal data like demographics, credit or browsing history, online and in stores.
local.title: NYC Council passes ban on 'surveillance pricing' that relies on personal data

local.h: Feds charge gang members in 2022 killing of 12-year-old
local.b: Prosecutors say members of a Brooklyn gang fired into the wrong car in East Flatbush, killing a 12-year-old boy, after mistaking it for a rival's.
local.title: Feds say gang members killed 12-year-old in East Flatbush drive-by, targeting a rival

local.h: Developer next to Flatbush collapse had flouted city orders
local.b: Buildings department records show the owner of the lot being excavated beside the collapsed building kept demolishing after a stop work order earlier this year and was penalized again.
local.title: Developer at Brooklyn collapse site had record of flouting orders from city agency

local.h: Bill would make delivery apps pay for e-bike fixes
local.b: A City Council bill from Councilmember Harvey Epstein would require food delivery companies to fund fixes for crowded e-bike parking, like the East Village block where hundreds of bikes line the curb.
local.title: NYC bill would require food delivery firms to fund fixes to the e-bike 'crisis'

local.h: New Yorkers line up to become casino dealers
local.b: Big Deal Casino Academy in NoMad, the city's only Education Department-licensed dealer school, is scaling up as New York City's first full-scale casino, in Jamaica, finally arrives.
local.title: A good bet: New Yorkers are lining up to become casino dealers

local.b: New diverters on Driggs Avenue force drivers to turn near McGolrick Park, a model city lawmakers want citywide. A ballot measure passed last week could speed such redesigns.
local.title: North Brooklyn street redesign paves the way for NYC's 'low-traffic neighborhood' plan

local.h: Flatbush building collapse death toll rises to eight
local.b: City officials said Thursday the collapse of a three-story apartment building in Flatbush has killed eight people and injured at least 25, including at least seven children, as crews kept searching the rubble.
local.title: FDNY ends search at Brooklyn building collapse: 6 adults, 2 children dead, 18 injured

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: A 30 percent chance of rain before 7pm.  Cloudy, with a steady temperature around 40. Northwest wind around 10 mph.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: Partly sunny, with a high near 48. Northwest wind 10 to 15 mph.

periods.name: Saturday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a steady temperature around 47. West wind around 14 mph.

periods.name: Sunday
periods.text: Sunny, with a high near 49. Northwest wind 13 to 15 mph.

periods.name: Sunday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 43.

localgood.h: Housing slashed homeless New Yorkers' ER costs, study finds
localgood.b: A small study found health care costs fell sharply for homeless patients after NYC Health and Hospitals helped house them, while their spending on preventive care rose.
localgood.title: Homeless New Yorkers’ healthcare costs plummeted after getting housed, study finds
